summary: SF_WOOD_GRAIN_FILL_NC_v1 passes QA with 4 minor warnings and 0 blockers. All 5 pipeline files reviewed. Cross-file threading validated: 6 TSK_GRAIN_* IDs in sop_modules match 6 rates in production. Single SF-based paintable item (ITM_GRAIN_FILL_SURFACE). First add-on spec in the system — standalone process that chains between parent prime and parent finish specs. Quality tier drives fill coat count (1/2/3). Surface profile is dominant modifier (1.0-2.8x). No protection zones (parent spec workspace). New state SS_GRAIN_FILLED proposed. Max modifier stacking 4.2x exceeds 4.0x flag threshold — documented and flagged for review. Human Feedback Gate has NOT occurred — expected for v0.1.0 draft.

rule_1_tsk_sop_to_production.details: All 6 TSK_GRAIN_* task IDs in sop_modules.json have matching entries in production.json. Complete list: SAND_PREP, FILL_COAT, SAND_BETWEEN, FINAL_SAND, PRIME_SEAL, SAND_PRIME.

rule_2_itm_in_variants.details: ITM_GRAIN_FILL_SURFACE is the sole paintable item. All 3 variants (VAR_GRAIN_QT3, VAR_GRAIN_QT4, VAR_GRAIN_QT5) implicitly include it as the single item.

rule_3_sys_qt_match.details: SYS_GRAIN_FILLER_WB in materials.json has coats_by_qt covering QT3/QT4/QT5, matching spec.json configuration_dimensions quality_tier values.

rule_4_inputs_consumed.details: Both IN_ inputs consumed: IN_SF_GRAIN_FILL (PS_SURFACE_SF.GRAIN_FILL — primary surface SF for all tasks), IN_ENUM_HEIGHT_BAND (PS_META.HEIGHT_BAND — height modifier selection). Materials.json required_inputs declares both.

rule_5_ps_keys_match.details: All PS_ keys referenced in sop_modules/production match spec.json required_paintscope_inputs: PS_SURFACE_SF.GRAIN_FILL (proposed new key), PS_META.HEIGHT_BAND (existing).

rule_6_zones_match.details: No protection zones declared in spec.json — no zone_ids to match. Consistent across all files. Add-on spec runs within parent spec's protected workspace.

rule_7_phase_order.details: Module sequence_order: prep(1) > apply(2) > interstage(3) > prep(4, QT5 final sand) > prime(5). All module phase values are valid per controlled_enums.json.

rule_8_uom_match.details: UOM consistent across all 6 tasks between sop_modules and production: all 6 tasks are SF with SF rates (rate_per_hour). No EA or FIXED tasks. All paintscope_key references match PS_SURFACE_SF.GRAIN_FILL.

rule_9_tsk_prefix.details: All 6 tasks use TSK_GRAIN_ prefix per context prefix GRAIN. No prefix deviations.

rule_10_itm_ids.details: ITM_GRAIN_FILL_SURFACE is proposed (new), correctly requires registration.

rule_11_enum_values.details: All enum values used across files are valid. quality_tier: QT3/QT4/QT5 (QT2 excluded). surface_profile: flat/light_profile/medium_profile/heavy_profile (new enum values, require registration). task_classification: binary/qt_scaled. unit_of_measure: SF. skill_level: journeyman. severity: critical/major/minor. consumable_category: abrasive/prep. No prohibited values detected.

interstage_module.details: MOD_GRAIN_INTERSTAGE with TSK_GRAIN_SAND_BETWEEN handles interstage sanding between fill coats.

sanding_block.details: production.json notes orbital sander on flats per FFD §15.4.1. Hand sand on profiles.

prep_tasks.details: TSK_GRAIN_SAND_PREP provides prep sanding before fill application.

geometry_validation.details: No internal geometry computation. All SF from PaintScope input PS_SURFACE_SF.GRAIN_FILL. UOM conversion happens in quantity-lookups.js, not in the spec.

modifier_validation.details: 3 modifiers: surface_profile (1.0-2.8x), wood_species (0.85-1.0x), height (1.0-2.0x). All documented as time_multipliers. Max stacking: heavy_profile(2.8) × H3(1.5) × deep_grain(1.0) = 4.2x — EXCEEDS 4.0x flag threshold. Documented in estimation_notes. Realistic worst case: ornate crown molding at 13+ ft height with deep-grain oak. Flagged for review but likely accurate.

issues.description: Production rate estimates need field validation. All rates are design doc estimates without field calibration data. Surface profile modifier values (especially medium_profile=2.0x and heavy_profile=2.8x) are aggressive and need confirmation.
issues.resolution: Flag for field validation. Rates are reasonable starting points but should be calibrated with actual job data.

issues.description: Max modifier stacking of 4.2x exceeds the 4.0x flag threshold. This occurs with heavy_profile (2.8x) × H3 (1.5x) × deep_grain (1.0x). While realistic for ornate crown molding at height, this is an edge case that may produce unexpectedly high estimates.
issues.resolution: Document in estimation_notes. Flag for review during field validation. Consider whether heavy_profile at H3+ is a realistic scenario.

issues.description: New IDs need registration: SF_WOOD_GRAIN_FILL_NC, ITM_GRAIN_FILL_SURFACE, SYS_GRAIN_FILLER_WB, SS_GRAIN_FILLED, PS_SURFACE_SF.GRAIN_FILL, IN_SF_GRAIN_FILL, TSK_GRAIN_* (6), MOD_GRAIN_* (5), ROUND_GRAIN_* (3), COV_GRAIN_* (2). Surface_profile enum values (flat, light_profile, medium_profile, heavy_profile) need registration.
issues.resolution: Update id_registry.json and controlled_enums.json after spec approval.

issues.description: New state SS_GRAIN_FILLED needs to be added as valid input state to all parent finish specs (SF_TRIM_NC_PAINT, SF_WOOD_WALL_NC, SF_CABINET_NC_PAINT, etc.) so the chain Parent Prime → Grain Fill → Parent Finish works correctly.
issues.resolution: After spec approval, update valid_input_states in all parent finish specs to include SS_GRAIN_FILLED.

doctrine_compliance.human_feedback_gate: NOT OCCURRED — expected for v0.1.0 draft

brief_compliance.acceptance_criteria_met: All design doc requirements implemented: 6 tasks as specified, QT-driven coat count, surface_profile/wood_species/height modifiers, AquaCoat material system, UOM conversion model, PS key PS_SURFACE_SF.GRAIN_FILL, state chain SS_PRIMED_* → SS_GRAIN_FILLED, wood species classification (open vs closed grain).

deviations.item: Design doc listed task IDs without TSK_ prefix
Design doc listed 'Sand Between' rate as 80 SF/hr without noting grit progression
deviations.resolution: Added grit progression detail (220→280-320→320) in task notes
